name: Sproutle at the campfire
notes: Sproutle on the intro screen. It only shows once it is unlocked (unlocked >= 5) and sits on the half circle behind the fire: its seat depends on how many monsters are unlocked, all of them spread evenly from left to right in roster order, so with 5 unlocked it takes seat 5. It always looks at the fire (view per number unlocked: 5: left, 6: down-left, 7: down-left, 8: down, 9: down). When it is shiny it shimmers through the rainbow, like everywhere else.
